<ṭitle page>
|| śrīḥ ||
<śrīrāmatoṣaṇa bhaṭṭācāryeṇa>
<śrījīvānandavidyāsāgarabhaṭṭācaryyeṇa prakāśitā |>
<1898 āḍ>
[5 bhaktikāṇḍa]
praṇamyeṣṭapadāmbhojaṃ caturvargaphalapradam |
pañcamaṃ bhaktikāṇḍañca tanoti rāmatoṣaṇaḥ |
nirghaṇṭo bhaktikāṇḍasya pañcamasyādhunocyate |
prātaḥkṛtyaṃ gaṇeśaya snānādi tadanantaram |
tarpaṇasya viśeṣastu phalaṃ tasya tataḥ param |
śrīgaṇeśabhūtaśuddhimātṛkānyāsanaṃ vinā |
karttavyakarmanindā ca ṣaḍaṅganyāsa eva ca |
mātṛkānyāsakṛtyasya prakārastadanantaram |
nyāsāntaraṃ tato dhyānaṃ yantrasya karaṇaṃ tataḥ |
pīṭhapūjādikañcāvāhanaṃ pūjākramastataḥ |
gandhāṣṭakaṃ gaṇeśasya puṣpañca tadanantaram |
dhūpadīpādibhedaścāvaraṇārccā tataḥ param |
puraścaryā gaṇeśasya kāmyakarma tataḥ param |
mahālakṣmyādikānāñca sādhanaṃ tadanantaram |
gaṇeśamantro yantrañca dhāraṇārhamataḥ param |
ākarṣaṇādikarmāṇi tato dhyānāntaraṃ tataḥ |
karmabhede varṇabhedo bījatrayaṃ gaṇeśituḥ |
dhyānāntaraṃ tato mudrā puraścaryāntaraṃ tataḥ |
tīvrādiśaktidhyānantu pīṭhamantrastataḥ param |
pūjāvaraṇapūjā cāṣṭabāhugaṇapārccanam |
tato mūṣikapūjā ca haridrāgaṇapodbhavaḥ |
gaṇeśopaniṣaccaiva stotraṃ gaṇapatestataḥ |
kavacaṃ gaṇanāthasya lipilambodarodbhavaḥ |
anyānyapi yathāsthānaṃ dṛṣṭvā jñeyāni paṇḍitaiḥ |
ityādimaparicchedasamāptirabhidhīyate |
vāṇaliṅgaṃ tasya bhedastaccihnaṃ tatparīkṣaṇam |
vāṇaśabdasya vyutpattirvāṇaliṅgapraśaṃsanam |
tatpūjanaphalañcaiva tatsthāpanaphalaṃ tataḥ |
rasaliṅgaphalañcaiva nindyaliṅgaṃ tataḥ param |
śubhaliṅgaṃ vāṇaliṅgamudbhūtikāraṇaṃ tataḥ |
vāṇaliṅgasthalaṃ vāṇaliṅgaṃ naikaprakārakam |
dhyānaṃ pūjā stavaścaiva raudraliṅgādilakṣaṇam |
śilā na mṛtsnādisambhūtaliṅgārcanaphalaṃ tataḥ |
dhātvādyadbhūtaliṅgasya saṃskārastadanantaram |
saśaktikaliṅgapūjāphalaṃ tattatpramāṇakam |
viprādibhede mṛtsnāyāḥ phalaṃ sthūlaṃ śilādijam |
phaladaṃ pañcasūtrādiliṅgavyatpattireva ca |
liṅgamāhātmyapūjādiphale ca tadanantaram |
rasaliṅgasya māhātmyaṃ talliṅganirmitistataḥ |
liṅgotpattirvaiṣṇavāderliṅgapūjādhikāritā |
tadakāṇanindādau śivaliṅgotpattirvaiṣṇavāderliṅgapūjādhikāritā |
tadakaraṇanindādau śivaliṅgārcanāvidhiḥ |
liṅgasya sthāpanaphalaṃ kāmyapūjā tataḥ param |
iti chedo dvitīyasya samāptirabhidhīyate |
tīrthādimṛttikā grāhyā śivanirmāṇakarmaṇi |
nadī kṣudralakṣaṇāñca liṅganirmītareva ca |
mṛttikāhakaraṇe mantro mantrājñāne ca nindanam |
nirmāṇamantrastatpramāṇaṃ pratiṣṭhānyāsa eva ca |
prāṇāyāmastato dhyānamāvāhanamataḥ param |
mantraḥ ṣaḍakṣaraḥ pūjāṣṭamūrtipūjanaṃ tataḥ |
japaḥ samarpaṇaṃ tasya mukhavādyaṃ tato natiḥ |
visarjanaṃ tataḥ pūjā sūtrañca tadanantaram |
tataśca pūjakasthānaṃ doṣā nyūnādhikena ca |
sarvāgrato liṅgapūjānyathā doṣastanantaram |
puṣpadānañcaiva tataḥ puṣpamāhātmyameva ca |
vijayāpatramāhātmyaṃ kāmyaliṅgārcanākramaḥ |
pratyahaṃ liṅgapūjā ca liṅgārpitaphalaṃ tataḥ |
riṣṭaśāntiśāntirekadinakṛtaliṅgārcanāphalam |
sārvakāmikapūjā cāgrāhyaṃ liṅgārpitaṃ tataḥ |
tātkāraṇañca pātrasthaṃ bhakṣyaṃ naivedyamuttamam |
śivasvagrahaṇe doṣastatprāyaścittameva ca |
vāṇaliṅgārpitaṃ grāhyaṃ svayambhādyarpitaṃ tathā |
nirmālyadravyanirṇītistathārṣādiṣvapi smṛtam |
tataḥ pāśupatāstrañca liṅgastotraṃ tataḥ param |
śivasya kavacaṃ vilvavṛkṣādimahimā tataḥ |
rudrākṣamahimā saṃvit prakaraṇaṃ tadanantaram |
tṛtīyacchedasampūrttiriti nirṇīyavemayā |
śālagrāmaśilotpattinidānaṃ cakrakāraṇam |
anudyogaviṣṇuśilālābhottamaphalaṃ tataḥ |
snigdhādiguṇadoṣāśca sakāme doṣanirṇayaḥ |
śālagrāmārccanaphalaṃ cakradvādaśakodbhavam |
phalañca cakrasaṃkhyābhiḥ śālagrāmanirūpaṇam |
śālagrāmasthitiphalaṃ tatprabhedastataḥ param |
viprādibhede cakrasya viśeṣastadanantaram |
saṃsparśārcāniṣedhastu rājanyādernirūpitaḥ |
bhojanasya ca nidāpi śālagrāmārccanaṃ vinā |
cakradvayaṃ tathā liṅgadvayaṃ nārcyaṃ gṛhe kvacit |
dvādaśādicakrapūjāphalaṃ cakrasya vikraye |
doṣastu na syāt cakrārcaphalañca tadanantaram |
gaṇḍakīdvārakācakrasaṅgamasya phalaṃ tataḥ |
śālagrāme viṣṇupūjāphalaṃ jñeyaṃ tataḥ param |
paricchedacaturthasya samāptirīritā |
dvārakācakracihnāni tanmāhātmyaṃ tataḥ param |
tasya varṇaviśeṣeṇa śubhāśubhaphalaṃ tataḥ |
nindā śilācakrabhede nāmabhedastataḥ param |
jīrṇoddhārādikarmāṇi śālagrāmaśilārccanāt |
tataśca ṣaṭpadīstotraṃ praṇāmaḥ prārthanā tataḥ |
caraṇāmṛtapānañca śirasā tasya dhāraṇam |
apītvā mūrdhnidharttuśca nindā viprāṅghrivāriṇaḥ |
pādaṃ naivedyadānasya mantraścārccanasūtrakam |
ṣoḍaśopacāramantrāḥ kāmyakarmma tataḥ param |
śrīviṣṇunāmamāhātmyaṃ śatanāma tataḥ param |
viṣṇapūjā kāṣṭhapātrādiṣu doṣāvahā tataḥ |
svarṇādipātre pūjātiphaladā tadanantaram |
puruṣasūktamāhātmyaṃ snānatryaphalaṃ tataḥ |
udvarttanasnānaphalaṃ phalaṃ śaṅkhe śubhāśubham |
tripadīlakṣaṇañcaiva tulasīmahimādi ca |
mālādhāraṇamapyuktaṃ vaiṣṇavasya praśaṃsanam |
daśāvatāratithyādiparicchedo'tra pañcamaḥ ||
mahāvidyānirṇayaśca tāsāṃ māhātmyakīrttanam |
mahāvidyāprabhṛtīnāṃ bhairavastadanantaram |
mahārātryādinirṇītirvidyotpattistataḥ param |
mahākālīsvarūpañcālīḍhādikīrtanaṃ tapaḥ |
kālīmantrapraśaṃsā cādyānindādoṣa eva ca |
kālīmantradvayañcaiva tābhyāṃ śāntyādireva ca |
mantradvayaphalañcaiva ṛṣyādinyāsa eva ca |
saṃyamāditantrakarma guruṇā kṛtyameva ca |
tatputrādyaiḥ svayaṃ vāpi nānyadvārā kadācana |
guruṇā kṛtatantroktakarmaṇaḥ phalanirṇayaḥ |
gurupatnyāḥ kṛte karmaṇyatra homo na vidyate |
purohitena vihitena vihite tasmin karmaṇi nindanam |
janasya sannidhau pūjāniṣedhaḥ parikīrtitaḥ |
athavā vuṣṇutantroktapūjā tatra vidhīyate |
iṣṭadevaṃ vinānyatra bhaktirnindā tathaiva ca |
pūjā ca trividhā vāhyapūjāphalamataḥ param |
pūjāsūtraṃ tataḥ saṅkṣepapūjāsūtrameva ca |
nityapūjāvidhānañca mantradvayapuraskriyā |
śatanāmastutiścaiva mahāvidyāstavastataḥ |
mahāvidyā kavacañca kālīkavacameva ca |
śāktapraśaṃsā viprāṇāṃ śāktatvakāraṇaṃ tataḥ |
śaktyupāsakabhartyasyānyopāsananiṣedhanam |
anyānyapi yathāsthānaṃ jñātavyāni manīṣibhiḥ |
iti ṣaṣṭhaparicchedasamāptirabhidhīyate |
ekavarṣādibhedena kumārīnāmanirṇayaḥ |
viśeṣastatra tatrāpi nānātantrānusārataḥ |
kumārīpūjanasthānaphalaṃ tatkālanirṇayaḥ |
tasyāḥ puṣpādidānasya bhojanasyāpi yat phalam |
pūjāsthānañca tatpaścāt kumārīpūjane manuḥ |
pūjākramaḥ kumārīṇāṃ praṇāmastadanantaram |
dakṣiṇādipradānañca kanyodvāphalaṃ tataḥ |
vivāhanāphalañcaiva tanmantrasya puraskriyā |
kumārikāpūjanasya prayogastadanantaram |
kumārīstavarājaśca kumārīkavacaṃ tataḥ |
brāhmaṇasya praśaṃsā cādhyāpakavṛttijaṃ phalam |
brahmaśāpaphalaṃ tīrthayātrā ca tadanantaram |
digviśeṣe ca yātrāyāṃ niṣiddhamāsanirṇayaḥ |
yoginīnirṇayaścaiva tithiyogaviśeṣayoḥ |
yoge yātrāniṣedhaśca tithyarkṣayogatastathā |
niṣedho janmamāsāderūṣādinirṇayastataḥ |
digviśeṣe ca yātrā tu digviśeṣamukhasya ca |
tatrāpi yātrikadravyaviśeṣanirṇayastataḥ |
gayāyā nirṇayaścaiva pretaśilānirūpaṇam |
golādiliṅganirṇītiḥ svapiṇḍadānameva ca |
āgastye tatphalañcaiva svakṛtyakālanirṇayaḥ |
tatra nāsti ca kālasya niyamaḥ śrāddhakarmaṇi |
viṣuvaśrāddhakaraṇe nirāmiṣaniṣedhanam |
āmaśrāddhe tvāmamāṃsaniṣedhaśca tataḥ param |
kṛte ca sāmiṣaśrāddhe nindā nirāmiṣāśane |
varṣaśrāddhādiṣu tathāmiṣadānavinirṇayaḥ |
kṛte nirāmiśaśrāddhe doṣastvāmiṣabhojane |
śudranimantraṇe viprabhuktinindā tataḥ param |
śrāddhe deyaṃ tathā māṃsaṃ tatphalañca tataḥ param |
varjyaṃ māṃsaṃ tathā deyā matsyā varjyāstathaiva ca |
dhūpapakvakadalyādiniṣedhastadanantaram |
śrāddhe pātraviśeṣānnaistṛptikālanirūpaṇam |
nimantraṇāpakrāntau ca kāśīmāhātmyameva ca |
iti saptamavicchedasamāptiḥ kathitā mayā ||
idaṃ saptabhirvistṛtaṃ bhaktikāṇḍaṃ paricchedarūpaiḥ phalaiḥ saṃyutañca |
yadarthaṃ surāmānavāḥ kinnarādyāstapaścerurugraṃ galatparṇabhogaiḥ |
ādeṣṭṭatvarayā na kāṇḍamatulaṃ bhīmāṃsitaṃ yanmayā dhīrā (!) nopahasantu tena paravighnasyedṛśī durgatiḥ |
paśyantve kamanīhamīśamasakṛnmāyāguṇairdustyajairnānārūpadharaṃvibh uṃ tvamahamityāviṣṭacittaṃ sadā ||
atha gaṇeśaprakaraṇam ||
kulamūlāvatārakalpasūtraṭīkādhṛtadvitīyakāṇḍīyagaṇeśa(-) vimarṣiṇyām ||
brāhmye muhūrte utthāya śirasi śvetapaṅkaje |
śvetavarṇaṃ mukhāsīnaṃ varadābhayapāṇikam |
dvinetraṃ śāntavadanaṃ smṛtvā nijaguruṃ punaḥ |
praṇipatya yathānyāyaṃ vahirnirgatya sādhakaḥ |
vihitāvaśyakaṃ śaucamācāmaṃ dantadhāvanam |
mukhaprakṣālanādīni kṛtvā snānaṃ samācaret |
hṛnmantrāṅkuśamantrābhyāṃ tīrthaṃ savitṛmaṇḍalāt |
āvāhyāmbhasi saṃyojya somasūryāgnimaṇḍalam |
sañcintya mantrī tanmadhye nimajjya susamāhitaḥ |
mūlamantraṃ samārabhya manasā ca trivārakam |
samutthāya samācāntaḥ saḍaṅgīkṛtavigrahaḥ |
ātmānaṃ mūlamantreṇa mudrayā kalasākhyayā |
saptakṛtvo'bhiṣicyātha manunāmantritaṃ jalam |
pītvācamyātha vimale vāsasī paridhāya ca |
punarācamya vinyasya ṣaḍaṅgamapi pūrvavat |
vāmahaste gṛhītādho galitodakavindubhiḥ |
saptadhā prokṣaṇaṃ kuryānmūlamantraṃ samuccaran |
avaśiṣṭodakaṃ dakṣahaste kṛtvā tu mantritam |
dineśāyotkṣipettiṣṭhan gāyatryārghyāñjalitrayam |
tathā |
sarvābhīṣṭapradaṃ vakṣye caturāvṛttitarpaṇam |
ekānte vijane'raṇye sarvopadravavarjite |
kṛtasnānādiko mantrī pūrvavannyāsasaṃyutaḥ |
taḍāgamadhye sañcintya puṣpitaṃ nalinīvanam |
tasya madhye mahāpadmaṃ taruṇādityasannibham |
samunnataṃ sugandhāḍhyaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ manoharam |
sadyo vikasitaṃ dhyāyedathavā nirmalaughavān |
yathāvittānusāreṇa sauvarṇādiśarāvakam |
pṛthulaṃ suviśālāsyaṃ nūtanaṃ mṛṇmayantu vā |
bhadrāsanantu saṃsthāpya nadīnadataḍāgajaiḥ |
śuddhodakaiḥ samāpūrya tatra vā kamalaṃ smaret |
raupyasopānapaṅktyā tu ātmānaṃ gaṇanāyakam |
viniścitya samāgamya tadambhoruhamadhyataḥ |
upaviṣṭaṃ gaṇeśānaṃ sarvābharaṇasaṃyutam |
prakarairgandhakusumaiḥ samabhyarcya ca pūrvavat ||
sādhyamūrddhani nāsāgre nidhāyāmṛtadhārayā |
taccharīraṃ susañcintya dhyātvā gaṇapamastake |
candracandanakāśmīrakastūrīlolitairjalaiḥ |
prathamaṃ mūlamantreṇa caturvāraṃ pratarpya ca |
mithunaṃ ṣaḍagaṇeśañca śaṅkhapadmanidhī api |
svasvavījādikairyugmaiḥ svāhāntaiśca catuścatuḥ |
mūlamantraṃ caturvārapūrvakaṃ tarpayet sudhīḥ |
sambhūyāṣṭottaraśataṃ kaniṣṭho'yaṃ mataḥ kramaḥ |
yadvāṣṭavāraṃ mūlena tarpayitvā viśeṣavit |
śrītyādīni yugmāni nidhyantāni pṛthak pṛthak |
vibhajya caturāvṛttyā mūlapūrvaṃ pratarpayet |
evaṃ madhyakramo'yaṃ syād dviśataṃ ṣoḍaśottaram |
athavā mūlamantreṇa viṃśadvāraṃ pratarpya ca |
pūrvaṃ mantrākṣarairvyastaiḥ svāhāntaiśca catuścatuḥ |
mūlamantracaturvāraṃ pūrvavat sampratarpya ca |
mithunādīṣṭataḥ paścāt pūrvavat sampratarpayet |
bhavet sambhūya sacatuścatvāriṃśaccatuḥśatam |
jyeṣṭhakramo'yaṃ samproktastattvajñaistantravedibhiḥ |
itthaṃ sudhāmayajalairabhiṣicya kalevaram |
devaṃ punaśca santoṣya gandhādyairdeśakālavit |
sarvābhīṣṭatamaṃ prārthya namaskṛtya samudvaset |
evaṃ yo'nudinaṃ mantrī dinādau sampratarpayet |
maṇḍalāt sakalābhīṣṭaṃ nirvighnaṃ labhate dhruvam ||
śāradātilake trayodaśapaṭale'pi ||
tarpayet salilaiḥ śuddhairdineśaṃ gaṇanāyakam |
catuścatvāriṃśatāḍhyaṃ catuḥśatamatandritaḥ |
prāpnuyānmaṇḍalādarvāk abhīṣṭamadhikaṃ naraḥ |
tarpaṇe tu sarvamantrāṇāmayaṃ viśeṣaḥ |
krīḍan hemamayodayādriśikhare sthitvāvatīrṇaḥ kṣudhāṃ sopāneṣu sametya rukmakaliteṣvabjādibhaikṣyaṃ bahu |
bhuktvā prītamanā yathāpuramasau sampūjito vighnapaḥ kuryādityuṣasi smṛtaḥ śaśikalāklāmāṃstathā tarpitaḥ |
tarpaṇe tu gaṃ gaṇeśaṃ tarpayāmīti prayogaḥ |
kramāccatuḥśatamiti pratitithidravyacatuṣṭayena tāvān homaḥ |
anāvṛṣṭau bhaye ghore rājacaurādyupadrave |
mahāhave vivāde ca mahādāridryasaṅkaṭe |
vivāhādiṣu sarveṣu kāmeṣu ca viśeṣataḥ |
evaṃ pratarpaṇaṃ kuryānmānasaiśca prasannadhīḥ |
śrīgaṇeśaprabhāveṇa sarvaṃ siddhyati līlayā |
anākulamanā mantrī bhāvayedikṣusāgaram |
tanmadhye vidrumadvīpaṃ taruṇādityasannibham |
tasya madhye mahādivyajāmbūnadamayaṃ sthalam |
tasyorddhvaṃ kalpakodyāne viśālamaṇibhūtalam |
samayānilasaṃsevyaṃ jyotsnākālātapāruṇam |
tanmadhye maṇḍapaṃ divyaṃ maṇistambhavirājitam |
sāndrasindūrapaṅkena samāliptaṃ manoharam |
muktāmaṇivitānāḍhyaṃ puṣpamālāvirājitam |
ghaṇṭādhvajapatakābhirujjvalaṃ sumanoharam |
itthaṃ sañcintya tanmadhye surasaṅghaiḥ supūjitam |
vasantādyṛtubhiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ mevitaṃ yugapat sadā |
maṇiratnaprabālāḍhyaṃ phalaprasavapallavaiḥ |
śobhitaṃ sarvaphaladaṃ mahākalpataruṃ smaret |
tatra kalpatarormūle navaratnaiḥ samaṃ mahat |
siṃhāsanañca tanmadhye lasatṣaṭkoṇakarṇikam |
ambhoruhaṃ lipiriyaṃ bhāvayenmantravittamaḥ |
bhūtaśuddhiprakaraṇam ||
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi bhūtaśuddhiṃ yathāvidhi |
dhvajamūlagudādhastād dakṣapādāṅghripārṣṇinā |
ṛjukāyaśirogrīvaḥ saṃyatendriyamānasaḥ |
aṅkasaṃlagnapāṇiśca nāsāgranyastalocanaḥ |
pūrṇasvadehaśuṣiramāpādāṅguṣṭhamastakam |
sañcinya vyāpinīṃ śaktiṃ śarīrāntaravāhyataḥ |
sāhaṅkāramanojīvaprāṇān saṃyamya pūrvakān |
gurūpadiṣṭamārgeṇa mūlādhārānnayet sudhīḥ |
utthāpya kuṇḍalīśaktimātmānañca tayā saha |
ekīkṛtyāstramantreṇa granthividrāvaṇakramāt |
haṃsena kumbhakoddvātaparānando'rddhamarccayet ||
sauṣumnamadhyamārgeṇa jīvātmānamananyadhīḥ |
uttamāṅgāttamānīya dvādaśāntargate śive (!) |
niyojya tattvavarṇāṃśca vilīnān paribhāvya ca |
nābhau savindukaṃ dhūmraṃ vahnibījaṃ vicintya ca |
kalevarañca haṃsena śoṣayeccaṇḍavāyunā |
udghātapañcakenātha hṛdayāmbusaroṃruhe |
ṣaṭkoṇe narasiṃhārṇajvālāmālāsamākulam |
sañcintyopadhanaṃ mūlyamakalmaṣamanāmayam |
tadvījajvālayā dagdhvā bhasmībhūtaṃ vibhāvya ca |
tadbhasmakūṭamakhilaṃ vahnibījotthavāyunā |
vikrīrya saṃyataḥ paścād dvādaśārṇaṃ cidantare |
śivaśaktisamudbhūtaistattvādyaiḥ sṛṣṭimārgataḥ |
kalevaraṃ samutpādya tejorūpaṃ mahāmayam |
ciccandrabījamadhyasthaṃ jalabījamanusmaret |
tadudbhūtāmṛtāmbhodhau cintayedvudbudaṃ mahat |
tato vudbudamadhyasthaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ samanusmaret |
tasmin viśvaṃ tato devīṃ dhyātvā taddhṛdayāmbuje |
so'haṃdhiyātmacaitanyaṃ samanīya cidambarāt |
tataḥ susthiramātmānaṃ bhūbījena vicintayet |
sa vāhyābhyantaraṃ dehaṃ saṃplāvyaṃ sudhayā punaḥ |
svasthānamāgatāṃ śaktiṃ bhāvayenmanasā sudhīḥ |
evaṃ kṛtvā bhūtaśuddhiṃ punarnyāsaṃ samācaret ||
mātṛkānyāso'pi tatraiva ||
japādau sarvamantrāṇāṃ vinyāsena lipervinā |
kṛtantu niṣphalaṃ vidyāt tasmāt pūrvāṃ lipiṃ nyaset |
ṣaṇḍavaryairvisargādyairādyairdvādaśabhiḥ svaraiḥ |
puṭitaiḥ kādiṣaḍvargairmantrī kuryāt ṣaḍaṅgakam |
keśānte mukhavṛtte ca cakṣuṣoḥ śravaṇadvaye |
nāsāgaṇḍauṣṭhadantānāṃ dvandve mūrddhvāsyayoḥ svarān |
varṇān pañca cavargāṇāṃ bāhvoścaraṇasandhiṣu |
pārśvayoḥ pṛṣṭhato nābhau hṛdaye ca kramānnyaset |
yādivargān dhātuprāṇeṣvātmakenātmanaḥ kramāt |
nyasyaivaṃ mātṛkāṃ paścādityevaṃ nyāsamācaret |
nyasyaivaṃ mātṛkāṃ paścānmūlamantreṇa pañcadhā |
sthāneṣu vakṣyamāṇeṣu vinyaset prayatātmavān |
mūrddhāsyahṛdguhyapādahṛtsu bījāni ṣaṭ kramāt |
vinyasya vyāpayecchiṣṭān mantrārṇān sarvavigrahe |
śirolalāṭadṛgvaktracūḍājihvāsu vinyaset |
ṣaḍbījāni mukhe śiṣṭermantrāṇaiḥ sarvavigrahe |
śirobhrūmamadhyayoḥ śrotre netranāsāyugeṣvapi |
vaktre karapadadvandvaṃlasatsandhicatuṣṭaye |
karpūre hṛdayāmbhoje mantrārṇairvyāpakaṃ tanau |
śirovaktrahṛdambhojaguhyapatsvapi pañcakam |
mithunānāṃ nyaset svīyaiḥ svabījairnāmabhiḥ pṛthak |
akhilāgamatattvajñairīśānaśivadeśikaiḥ |
pañcamaṃ mithunaṃ proktaṃ ṣaṣṭhañca kamalātmakam |
atha mūlaṣaḍaṅgāni vinyaseduktamānataḥ |
bījaṣaṭkaiścāgamādyairvahnerjātisamanvitaiḥ |
aṅguṣṭhādikaniṣṭhāntamutpattirbrahmacāriṇām |
madhyāditarjanyavadhi gṛhasthānāṃ sthitirbhavet |
aṅguṣṭhāntaṃ kaniṣṭhādi yatīnāṃ saṃhṛtirbhavet |
āśramānuguṇaṃ mantrī karayorubhayorapi |
aṅgulīṣu ca sāgreṣu talayorapi pṛṣṭhayoḥ |
nyasya hṛdādimudrābhirhṛdayādiṣu vinyaset |
tathā |
mūrddhni netre ca jihvāyāṃ hṛnnābhiśirajānuṣu |
vināyakādivighneśān caraṇāgre ca vinyaset |
vināyako virūpākṣaḥ krūrakarmāparājitaḥ |
caṇḍavego hayagrīvaḥ karālaścaṇḍavikramaḥ |
tathā |
sakaṇṭhāṃśeṣu teṣveva vinyaset sādhakottamaḥ |
vighno vināyako vīraḥ śūro vadana eva ca |
gajavaktrastataḥ paścādekadantastataḥ param |
lambodaraḥ kṣiprasaṃjño mahāgaṇapa eva ca |
brahmāṇyādyāstathā mātṝrasitāṅgādibhairavān |
śaktibījādikāṃścāṣṭau nijasthāneṣu vinyaset |
bhāladoḥstanapārśveṣu jaṭhare dakṣapārśvake |
dakṣakaṇṭhāparagale hṛdayeṣu yathākramam |
evaṃ nyāsaṃ vinirvarttya dhyānaṃ kuryāt samāhitaḥ |
siddhilakṣmīsamāśliṣṭapārśvamarddhenduśekharam |
āraktavarṇaṃ mātuluṅgagadāpuṇḍrekṣukārmukam |
śūlaṃ sudarśanaṃ śaṅkhaṃ nīlotpalaṃ dhānyamañjarīm |
nijadantā ratnaghaṇṭā parindrapāṇyekādaśakam |
prabhinnakaṭamānandapūrṇamaśeṣadhvaṃ sakaraṃ vighneśvaraṃ daśabhujaṃ dhyāyediti kecit |
atha dhyānaṃ pravakṣyāmi vyāptisaṃsāradehataḥ |
kṣmāpadaṃ khatanutraye jaṭharaṃ pavanākṣaram |
ravīnduvahninayanaṃ daśāśāśravaṇadvayam |
pradhānaśīrṣaṃ bhūteśaṃ buddhīndriyaviceṣṭitam |
anādinidhanaṃ divyaṃ tejorāśimanāmayam |
dhyāyeddevaṃ gaṇeśānaṃ saccidānandavigraham |
evaṃ vyāptiṃ samākhyāya sākāraṃ dhyānamucyate |
anākulamanā mantrī bhāvayedikṣusāgaram |
tatra madhye samāsīnaṃ gajavaktraṃ trilocanam |
ekadantaṃ daśabhujaṃ kamba grīvaṃ mahodaram |
padmasthadakṣacaraṇalambimadhyapadāmbujam |
taruṇādityasaṅkāśaṃ pītāmbarasamāvṛtam |
sandhyāruṇakapardāntasauvarṇābharaṇānvitam |
śaśāṅkārddhakṛtottaṃsaṃnāgayajñopavītinam |
ratnaughahārollasitaviśālavaravakṣasam |
maṇimuktāprabālāṭyaṃ kaṭisūtrapariṣkṛtam |
kiṅkiṇīmālayā baddhavāmajaṅghāvirājitam |
dakṣādho hastamārabhya dhārayā lambamānayā |
gadāśūlavarttikadruviṣāṇān dakṣiṇairbhujaiḥ |
śālyagrapāśacakrekṣucayasaṃbījapūrakān |
bījapūragadāmikṣucāpaśūlasudarśanān |
abjapāśopalavrīhiviṣāṇānapare viduḥ |
vāme'ṅgadharamañjīravilasaccaraṇāmbujam |
vāmāṅgasaṃsthayā śaktyā sarvālaṅkārayuktayā |
ambhojakarayāśliṣṭaṃ sarvaiśvaryamukhapradam |
līlayā ratnakalasaṃ puṣkarāgre nidhāya ca |
paritaḥ sādhakaṃ śaśvadvarṣantaṃ ratnavarṣaṇaiḥ |
procchalatkarṇatālena madalolupaṣaṭpadān |
nirvāsayantaṃ satataṃ devāsuraniṣevitam |
vīranādoddhatodgītaiḥ stotraiḥ sampūrṇamānasaḥ |
devaṃ mahāgaṇeśānaṃ dhyātvā sādhakapuṅgava iti |
asya yantrakaraṇamapi tatraiva ||
kusodenāmbukastūrīcandracandanakuṅkumaiḥ |
ālikhya hemasūcyā vā dūrvākāṇḍena vā likhet |
padmaṃ saṃlikhya matimān samarekhaṃ suśobhanam |
sthāpayet kanake pīṭhe tadabhāve vicakṣaṇaḥ |
śrīparṇosambhave vātha caturasre sunirmite |
pūrvaṃ svavāmetarayoriṣṭvā gurugaṇeśvarau |
tayorājñāṃ samāsādya pīṭhapūjāmupakramet |
ādhāraśaktiṃ cānantaṃ kūrmavat pṛthivīṃ kramāt |
uparyupari sampūjya paścāddikṣvantarādibhiḥ |
siṃhāsanantu manubhiḥ pūjayecca yathākramam |
ādhāraśaktirāsīnā śuklābharaṇabhūṣitā |
dhyātavyā dhavalaprekṣyā lokān dhatte śivājñayā |
tattvairdharādividyāntairdvātriṃśatsaṃkhyakairiha |
pīṭhākārai hyanantaḥ syādanantāsanamīritam ||
tathā |
dharmaṃ jñānañca vairāgyamaiśvaryañca catuṣṭayam |
etat siṃhāsanapade catuṣṭayamiti kalpasūtraṭīkāvyākhyānam |
pīṭhāgneyādipādeṣu caturṣvapi yathākramam |
adharmādicatuṣkañca pūrvādyāśācatuṣṭaye |
dharmaṃ raktaṃ vṛṣākāraṃ siṃhaṃ jñānañca mecakam |
bhūtākārantu vairāgyamaiśvaryaṃ sitamaindavam |
īśāḥ syuḥ kanakamaṇipīṭhe dharmādayaḥ kramāt |
tathā |
sattvaṃ rajastamaścaiva tatpīṭhakamalopari |
māyāñca śūlikākārāṃ vidyāṃ pracchadarūpiṇīm |
uparyupari sampūjyamānandaṃ lipipaṅkajam |
tanmadhye pūjayenmantrī tadūrdhve maṇḍalatrayam |
dale'rkamaṇḍala paścāt keśare somamaṇḍalam |
karṇikāyāṃ tataḥ paścāt pūjyaṃ vahneśca maṇḍalam |
praṇavāvayavārṇādyairarccayennāmabhiḥ kramāt |
brahmaviṣṇvīśvarā bhāvyāḥ kramaśo maṇḍalatraye |
ātmānamantarātmānamuparyupari pūjayet |
pīṭhaśaktīḥ keśareṣu madhye prāgāditaḥ kramāt |
pāśāṅkuśakarā dhyeyā navakuṅkumasannibhāḥ |
tīvrādyāḥ pūjanīyāḥ syuḥ śaktayo maṇibhūṣaṇāḥ |
tīvrā ca jvālinī nandā bhogadā kāmavarddhinī |
ugratejovatī satyā navamī vighnanāśinī |
sarvaśaktipadaṃ coktvā kamalāpadamuccaret |
sanāyeti namo'bhyarcya gandhapuṣpākṣataiḥ śubhaiḥ |
samāptipīṭhaṃ tanmadhye mantrī pūrvatrayaṃ kṣipet |
tataḥ pūrakayogeṇa mūlaṃ saṃyojya mānasam |
tatrasthajīvacaitanyamunnīya hṛdayāmbuje |
pūrvoktavidhinopetamicchayā śrīgaṇeśvaram |
sarvopacārairārādhya prasannaṃ puruṣaṃ punaḥ |
svatejorūpatāṃ nītvā tattejaḥ saṃyatendriyaḥ |
mantrakāṇḍaṃ samunnīya tatra pāṇḍarapaṅkaje |
tejastattvaṃ sumañcintya mantrī niścalamānasaḥ |
kodaṇḍasthānamānīya puṣpapūrṇakarāmbujau |
niḥsārya pravahannāḍyā pūjite pīṭhapaṅkaje |
madhye mūrtiñca gāyatryā vidyā dehaṃ tadantare |
bījena paracaitanyatanmūrttiṃ hṛdayāmbuje |
mahāgāṇapatītyuktvā mūrttaye nama ityarthaḥ |
gaṇeśamāvāhayāmi vidyā dehañca mūlataḥ |
tathaiva paracaitanyaṃ mantrajñaḥ sādhakottamaḥ |
śrīdeśikoktamārgeṇa samyagāvāhayet sudhīḥ |
tattvavarṇānnyasenmūrtau vidyādehe tataḥ param |
nyāsaṃ sarvaṃ pravinyasya prāgvaddhyātvā samarcayet |
tatra caitanyamāpādya pañca mudrāḥ pradarśayet ||
tadyathā ||
sthāpanaṃ sannidhānañca sannirodhāvaguṇṭhane |
amṛtīkaraṇaṃ paścādetā mudrāḥ prakīrtitāḥ |
sarvajñatā ca hṛdaye tatastṛptiḥ śive punaḥ |
anādibodhañca śikhā śastraṃ cānantaśaktitaḥ |
etairjātiyutairaṅgairupadeśavidhānataḥ |
hṛdayādiṣu vinyasya mūlena vyāpakaṃ nyaset |
gaṇeśamudrāḥ sandarśya paripūrṇaṃ gaṇeśvaram |
dhyātvā puṣpāñjaliṃ kurvan vijñāpya svāgataṃ punaḥ |
pādyādīnupacārāṃśca mantrī samyak samācaret |
āsanaṃ svāgatañcārghyaṃ pādyamācamanīyakam |
madhuvarkācamanasnānavasanābharaṇānyapi |
sugandhisumanodhūpadīpanaivedyavandanam |
prayojayed gaṇeśāya upacārāṃstu ṣoḍaśa |
pādyādayo naivedyāntā upacārā daśa kramāt |
gandhādayonaivedyāntā pūjā pañcopacārikā |
saparyā trividhā proktā tāsāmekāṃ samācaret |
gandhapuṣpākṣatayavakuśāgratisarṣapāḥ |
dūrvā ceti kramādarghyaṃ dravyāṣṭakamudīritam |
pādyaṃ śyāmākadūrvābjaviṣṇukrāntābhirucyate |
jātīlavaṅgakakkolairyutamācamanīyakam |
madhuparkañca sakṣaudraṃ ghṛtaṃ dadhi samīritam |
śuddhābhiradbhirvihitaṃ punarācamanīyakam |
candanāgurukarpūrakāśmīrakapirocanā |
jaṭhāmāṃsau ca coraśca etad gandhāṣṭakaṃ smṛtam |
candanāgurukarpūrapaṅairgandha ihocyate |
karavīrotpaladvandvavijayākusumāni ca |
punnāganāgacampāni kundamandārakāṇi ca |
bandhujīvajavānuśrīramānimbakuraṇṭakaiḥ |
pāṭalāśokamadanajātikuñjāparājitaiḥ |
nandhyāvarttādipūrvāṇi hyadyānyanyāni yāni ca |
āgamoktāni puṣpāṇi gaṇeśasya priyāmi ca |
mukulaiḥ parito mlānai jīrṇairvā kimidūṣitaiḥ |
āghrātairaṅgasaṃspṛṣṭairna ca paryuṣitairapi |
sadguggulvagurūśīrasitājyamadhucandanaiḥ |
sārāṅgāravinikṣiptairmantrīṃ nīcaiḥ pradhūpayet |
gosarpistilailena varttyā karpūragarbhayā |
dīpitaṃ surabhiṃ śuddhaṃ dīpamuccaiḥ pradarśayet |
asitena sugandhena sasarpiṣā sitaudanam |
samakadalamadhvājyadugdhādīni nivedayet |
tato devasya vijñāpya snānaṃ nama itīrayet |
keśaprasādhanābhyaṅgodvarttanoṣṇodakāni ca |
mahāgaṇapate (!) pādyaṃ nama ityeva pādayoḥ |
tadvadācamanīyañca svadheti trirmukhe dadet |
arghyaṃ svāheti śirasi madhuparkaṃ svadhā tathā |
punarācamanaṃ puṣpaṃ maulau pariśikhāṇunā |
pañcagavyaṃ tathā ṣaṣṭhaṃ gandhodvarttana meva ca |
sugandhāmalakīgandhastīrthodakamanantaram |
divyagandhānulepañca mūlamantrābhimantritaiḥ |
sugandhalohitaistīrthatoyairapyabhiṣecanam |
ādarśadarśanaṃ cānyamaṅgalācaraṇāni ca |
divyāṃśuke tataḥ paścānmukuṭāni ca kalpayet |
sambodhya mukhamākalpya kalpayāmītyudīrayet |
saṅkalpya pūrvavanmantrī pādyāditrikamācaret |
sagandhākṣatapuṣpāṇi dhūpañca svasvamudrayā |
hṛdayādikavacāntaistu manubhiḥ kramaśo'rcayet |
kṛtvā layañca pūjāñca mantrañcākṣarasaṃkhyayā |
japtvāvaraṇapūjāntaṃ devaṃ vijñāpya tat punaḥ |
aṅgānīṣṭvā tato mantrī vāhyāvaraṇamarccayet |
lokapālāstataḥ pūjyāḥ samastacaturasrakaiḥ |
puruhūteśayormadhye rakṣovaruṇayostathā |
brahmaviṣṇuśivādīni sadā śayyā vidhormukhe |
purandarādilokeśāḥ sajātyadhigahetavaḥ |
savāhaparivārāntāḥ prayoktavyā manīṣibhiḥ |
gurvādyā lokapālāntā ye mantrāste dhruvādikāḥ |
svasvabījānvitāḥ sarve sacaturthīnamo'ntikāḥ |
evamāvaraṇaṃ pūjya prasūnaiḥ kundasambhavaiḥ |
punardevañca mūlena samyaggandhādibhiryajet |
jayadhvani (!) tato mantramātaḥ (!) svāhetyudīryya ca |
abhyarcya vādayan ghaṇṭāṃ mahāpañcamahāravaiḥ |
vanaspatīti mantreṇa svāhāntena svamudrayā |
suprakāśeti mantreṇa namo'ntena svamudrayā |
sa sarvānnamṛtīkṛtya gaṇeśamanupūrvakam |
sanaivedyaṃ gṛhāṇānte svāhetyuktvā svamudrayā |
mudrayodakadānena mantrī sarvaṃ nivedayet |
devaṃ saparivārañca paritṛptaṃ vibhāvya ca |
tathā |
atha nityavidhiṃ kurvan puraścaryāṃ samācaret |
guruṇā dīkṣito mantrī pūrvavacca susaṃyutaḥ |
caturlakṣañca sacatuścatvāriṃśatsahasrakam |
manumenaṃ japet prājñaḥ puraścaraṇasiddhaye |
mauliniścalakaṇṭhauṣṭhajihvādṛgakṣayantritaḥ |
nāsātālugalajjihvāsṛkkaṇīnāṃ samālihan |
kiñcidunnatakagrīvaḥ kiñcitsaṅkocitekṣaṇaḥ |
nāsāgradattadṛṣṭiḥ san dantairdantānna saṃspṛśet |
taccittastadgataprāṇastanniṣṭhastatparāyaṇaḥ |
vācikenopāṃśunā ca mānasenāthavā sudhīḥ |
catuḥsahasraṃ sacatuścatvāriṃśattamaṃ yathā |
aṣṭottarasahasraṃ vā hariṣyāśī jitendriyaḥ |
yatsaṃkhyayā samārabdhaṃ tanmānaṃ pūrṇatāṃ nayet |
yadi nyūnādhikaṃ kuryādvratabhraṣṭo bhavennaraḥ |
tasmātsamaṃ japettāvadyāvat saṃkhyā samāpyate |
daśāṃśaṃ tarpaṇaṃ kuryāt sādhakendro'nuśāsanam |
itthaṃ jape tu sampūrṇe homaṃ kuryāddaśāṃśataḥ |
pūrvoktaistarpaṇādyaiśca saha bhaktiparāyaṇaḥ |
vakṣyamāṇakrameṇaiva karmānuguṇasaṃkhyakān |
sāṅgāya bhojayedaṅgān brāhmaṇān hṛṣṭamānasān |
gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād yathāvittānusārataḥ |
samprāpta gurukāruṇyaḥ paścānmantravidāṃ varaḥ |
prajapeccaturāvṛttyā yadvā nityaṃ svaśaktitaḥ |
kuryādyathāvat pūjādi homenātiprayatnataḥ |
vittaśāṭhyaṃ vinā nityaṃ mantrī vighneśvaraṃ bhajan |
nirvighnaṃ vatsarādarvāk mahatīṃ śriyamaśnute |
yadyagnikāryasampattirbaleḥ pūrvaṃ vidhānataḥ |
vidhinā saṃskṛte vahnau kuryāt pūrvakrameṇa ca |
paryyantaiśca hutvā mantrāsanavānadya trivāraṃ santarpyeti |
yogyairiti tattanmantrānuṣṭhānaparaiḥ |
prayogā api tatraiva |
itthaṃ siddhamanurmantrī kāmyakarmmāṇi sādhayet |
vakṣyāmi kāmyakarmāṇi sādhakānāṃ hitāya vai |
śāstroktaiva mārgeṇa saṃkṣepāt na tu vistarāt |
svahṛtpadme gaṇeśānaṃ kundendudhavalaprabham |
śuklālaṅkārasampannaṃ bhāvayed yo nirantaram |
bhāratī tasya vaktrābje śāstraughoddhārasundarī |
nityaṃ prakāśate satyaṃ divyajñānapradāyinī |
na nirasyedgaṇeśānaṃ sindūrasadṛśaprabham |

hemādridhṛtam ||

śubhaliṅgamāha vīramitrodaye ||

sūtasaṃhitāyāṃ bhairavākyam ||

jitakrodho'nuraktaśca śivapūjāvidhau rataḥ |

dine dine svayaṃ dattvā liṅgaṃ sthāpya prapūjayet |

śaṅkara uvāca ||
tuṣṭo'haṃ tava hevāṇa (!) varaṃ brūhi kimicchasi |
śaṅkarasya vacaḥ śrutvā vāṇo vacanamabravīt |
yadi tuṣṭo'si hīnāya mahyaṃ tvaṃ mandabhāgine |
kliṣṭo'haṃ tava deveśa (!) liṅgaṃ kṛtvā dine dine |
tattallakṣaṇasaṃsiddhalakṣaṇaṃ śāstranirmmitam |
śāstrārthau durlabhau deva (!) siddhaścārthaśca durlabhaḥ |
tasmāttvaṃ yadi me tuṣṭo liṅgaṃ dehi sulakṣaṇam |
sarvakāmakṛtārthañca sarvasattvānukampanam |
sarveṣāñca hitārthāya prasādaṃ kuru śaṅkara (!) |
ityevaṃ vacanaṃ tasya śivaḥ paramakāraṇam |
śrutvā kailāsamūrddhānaṃ śaṅkareṇa vinirmmitāḥ |
liṅgānāṃ koṭisaṃkhyāśca tathā caiva caturdaśa |
siddhaliṅgaṃ tadā tattat sarvaṃ sadodayaṃ svayam |
ayojyaivaṃ susampūrṇaṃ vāṇasya ca samarpitam |
akṣayaphaladaṃ vāṇaṃ sthāpyamānañca nityaśaḥ |
sampūjya vāṇaḥ sadbhāvaṃ kṛtvā praṇayanaṃ tadā |
tadbhāvaṃ svapuraṃ nītvā nyūnaṃ cintayate śuciḥ |
akṣayyaṃ yadi saṃsiddhaṃ sthāpyamānaṃ dine dine |
sattvānāṃ siddhihetvarthaṃ vāṇaḥ sthāne susaṃraye |
liṅgānāṃ kālikāgarte sañcitāstu trikoṭayaḥ |
śrīśailakoṭayastisraḥ koṭyekā kanyakāśrame |
māheśvare ca koṭistu kanyātīrthe tu koṭikā |
mahendre caiva nepāle ekaikā koṭireva ca |
vāṇārccārthaṃ kṛtaṃ liṅgaṃ vāṇaliṅgamataḥ smṛtam |
vāṇo vā śiva ityuktastatkṛtaṃ vāṇamucyate |
tasmātteṣu pradeśeṣu puṇyasthāneṣu teṣu vā |
sthitaṃ tacchivasadbhāvaṃ śivasyākṛtivigrahe |
hemnā tadākṛtilakṣaṇaṃ samuccaye'pi |
svayambhūliṅgavadvāṇaliṅgaṃ bhuktyai svamuktaye |
sahasraphalamanyasmād yathāsthānaprapūjane |
śrīśaile kālikāgarte liṅgādrau kanyakāśrame |
kanyātīrthe vane yāne mahendre vā sureśvare |
sthitāni vāṇaliṅgāni śivenaiva kṛtāni tu |
siddhāntaśekhare vāṇaliṅgānyadhikṛtya ||
tadā tvekaprakāraṃ syādanyavarṇamapīṭhakam |
lakṣmamūrtivihīnañca vāṇaṃ tatpṛthulāgrakamiti |
vāṇaliṅgeṣvāvāhanādi na karttavyam ||
taduktaṃ bhaviṣye ||
vāṇaliṅgāni rājendra (!) sthitāni bhuvanatraye |
na pratiṣṭhā na saṃskārasteṣāmāvāhanaṃ na ceti ||
yogasāre pañcamaparicchede ||
brāhmye muhūrte cotthāya yaḥ smaredvāṇaliṅgakam |
sarvatra jayamāpnoti satyaṃ satyaṃ maheśvara (!) ||
atha vāṇaliṅgadhyānaṃ tatraiva ||
oṃ pramattaṃ śaktisaṃyuktaṃ vāṇākhyañca mahāprabham |
kāmavāṇānvitaṃ devaṃ saṃsāradahanakṣamam |
śṛṅgārādirasollāsaṃ vāṇākhyaṃ parameśvaram |
evaṃ dhyātvā vāṇaliṅgaṃ yajettaṃ paramaṃ śivam |
manasā gandhapuṣpādyaiḥ sampūjyāsya manuṃ smaret ||
tathā |
prāṇāyāmaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā vāṇaliṅgantu toṣayet |
tadiṣṭadevayoraikyaṃ vibhāvya vāgbhavaṃ japet |
tato japaṃ samāpyātha stavenānena toṣayet ||
atha stavaḥ ||
oṃ vāṇaliṅga (!) mahābhāga (!) saṃsārāt trāhi māṃ prabho (!) |
namaste cograrūpāya namaste vyaktayonaye |
saṃsārakāriṇe tubhyaṃ namaste sūkṣmarūpadhṛk (!) |
pramattāya mahendrāya kālarūpāya (!) vai namaḥ |
dahanāya namastubhyaṃ namaste yogakāriṇe |
bhogināṃ bhogakartre ca mokṣadātre namo namaḥ |
namaḥ kāmāṅganāśāya namaḥ kalmaṣahāriṇe |
namo viśvapradātre ca namo viśvasvarūpiṇe |
vāṇasya varadātre ca rāvaṇasya kṣayāya ca |
rāmasyānugrahārthāya rājyāya bharatasya ca |
munīnāṃ yogadātre ca rākṣasānāṃ kṣayāya ca |
namastubhyaṃ namastubhyaṃ namastubhyaṃ namo namaḥ |
aiṃ dāhikāśaktiyuktāya mahāmāyāpriyāya ca |
bhagapriyāya sarvāya vairiṇāṃ nigrahāya ca |
paritrāṇāya yogināṃ kaulikānāṃ priyāya ca |
kulāṅganānāṃ bhaktāya kulācāraratāya ca |
kulabhaktāya yogāya namo nārāyaṇāya ca |
madhupānapramattāya yogeśāya namo namaḥ |
kulanindāpraṇāśāya kaulikānāṃ sukhāya ca |
kulayogāya niṣṭhāya śuddhāya paramātmane |
paramātmasvarūpāya liṅgamūlātmakāya ca |
sarveśvarāya sarvāya śivāya nirguṇāya ca |
ityetat paramaṃ guhyaṃ vāṇaliṅgasya śaṅkara (!) |
yaḥ paṭhet sādhakaśreṣṭho gāṇapatyaṃ labheta saḥ |
stavasnāsya prasādena yogī yogītvamāpnuyāt |
rājyārthināṃ bhavedrājyaṃ bhogināṃ bhoga eva ca |
sādhūnāṃ sādhanaṃ deva (!) kaulikānāṃ kulaṃ bhavet |
yaṃ yaṃ kāmayate mantrī taṃ tamāpnoti līlayā |
vāṇaliṅgaprasādena sarvamāpnoti satvaram |
kimanyat kathayāmīha sarvaṃ vetsi kuleśvara (!) |
mahābhaye samutpanne rājadvāre kuleśvara (!) |
deśāntarabhaye prāpte dasyucaurādisaṅkule |
paṭhanāt stavarājasya na bhayaṃ labhate kvacit |
vāṇaliṅgasya māhātmyaṃ saṃkṣepāt kathitaṃ mayā |
tasya śravaṇamātreṇa naro mokṣamavāpnuyāt |
vāṇaliṅgaṃ sadārādhyaṃ yogināṃ yogasādhane |
kaulikānāṃ kulācāre paśūnāṃ śatruvigrahe |
vedajñānāṃ vedapāṭhe rogiṇāṃ roganāśane |
yo yo nārādhayedenaṃ sarvaṃ tanniṣphalaṃ bhavet ||

samuccaye'pi ||

kṛtrimaṃ nirmmitaṃ dhātuliṅgādi |
siddhāntaśekhare |
natvā nāradamāryādīn liṅgaṃ piṣṭākāravindurūpiṇau |
brāhmī śilotkalārūpā vakṣye liṅgasya lakṣaṇam |

pratyekaṃ trividhaṃ jñeyaṃ liṅgaṃ tadubhayātmakam |
prāsāde sthāpitaṃ liṅgamacalaṃ tacchilādijam |
sthāpitamacalaṃ gehe sthiraṃ liṅgamayojite |
pañcadhā tat sthitaṃ liṅgaṃ svayambhūdaivapālakam |

ācāryamunaye svairaṃ svayambhūto maheśvaraḥ |

siddhāntaśekhare ||
nānācchidrasusaṃyuktaṃ nānāvarṇasamanvitam |
adṛṣṭamūlaṃ yalliṅgaṃ karkaśaṃ bhuvi dṛśyate |
talliṅgantu svayambhūtamaparaṃ lakṣaṇacyutam |
svayambhūliṅgamityuktaṃ tacca nānāvidhaṃ matam |
śaṅkhābhamastakaṃ liṅgaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tadudāhṛtam |
padmābhamastakaṃ brāhmyaṃ chatrābhaṃ śākramucyate |
śiroyugmaṃ tadāgneyaṃ tripadaṃ yāmyamīritam |

vāyavyaṃ dhvajavalliṅgaṃ kauverantu gadānvitam |
īśānasya triśūlābhaṃ lokapālādiniḥsṛtam |
svayambhū liṅgamākhyātaṃ sarvaśāstraviśāradaiḥ ||
iti svayambhūliṅgalakṣaṇam ||
matsyasūkte ||

eteṣāṃ pūjāphalantu tatraiva ||

padmapurāṇam ||

vīramitrodayadhṛtakalpottare'pi ||

anantādyāḥ smṛtā hyaṣṭau maṇayo vidyudujjvalāḥ |

garuḍapurāṇe ||
kastūrikāyā dvau bhāgau catvāraścandanasya ca |
kuṅkumasya tayaścaiva śaśinā ca catuḥsamam |
etadvai gandhaliṅgantu kṛtvā sampūjya bhaktitaḥ |
śivasāyujyamāpnoti bandhubhiḥ sahito naraṃ |
kāryaṃ puṣpamayaṃ liṅgaṃ hayagandhasamanvitam |
navakhaṇḍāṃ dharāṃ bhuktvā gaṇeśādhipatirbhavet |

śrīkāmaḥ puṣṭikāmaśca putrakāmastadarccayet |

kīrtikāmo yajennityaṃ liṅgaṃ kāṃsyasamudbhavam |
śatrumāraṇakāmastu liṅgaṃ lauhamayaṃ sadā |
sadā sīsamayaṃ liṅgamāyuṣkāmo'rccayennaraḥ ||
lakṣaṇasamuccaye'pi |
sthiralakṣmīpradaṃ haimaṃ rājataṃ caiva rājyadam |
prajāvṛddhikaraṃ rāṅgaṃ tāmramāyuḥpravarddhanam |
vidveṣakārakaṃ kāṃsyaṃ rītijaṃ śatrunāśanam ||
rītijaṃ pittalamayam ||
rogaghnaṃ saisakaṃ liṅgamāyasaṃ śatranāśanam |
aṣṭalauhamayaṃ liṅgaṃ kuṣṭharogakṣayāvaham |
trilauhasambhavaṃ liṅgaṃ vijñānaṃ prati siddhidam ||
liṅgapurāṇe ||
śrīpradaṃ vajrajaṃ liṅgaṃ śilājaṃ sarvasiddhidam |
dhātujaṃ dhanadaṃ sākṣāddārujaṃ bhogasiddhidam ||
kālottare ||
gandhapuṣpamayaṃ liṅgaṃ tathānnādivinirmitam |
kastūrīsambhavaṃ liṅgaṃ dhanākāṅkṣī prapūjayet |
liṅgaṃ gorocanotthañca rūpakāmastu pūjayet |
kāntikāmastu satataṃ liṅgaṃ kuṅkumasambhavam |
śvetāgurusamudbhūtaṃ mahābuddhivivarddhanam |
dhāraṇāśaktidaṃ liṅgaṃ kṛṣṇāgurusamudbhavam ||
mātṛkābhedatantre dvādaśapaṭale ca ||
pārthive śivapūjāyāṃ sarvasiddhiyuto bhavet |
pāṣāṇe śivapūjāyāṃ dviguṇaṃ phalamīritam |
svarṇaliṅge ca pūjāyāṃ śatrūṇāṃ nāśanaṃ matam |
sarvasiddhiśvaro raupyai phalaṃ tasmāccaturguṇam |
tāmre puṣṭiṃ vijānīyāt kāṃsye ca dhanasaṃkṣayaḥ |
gaṅgāyāñca lakṣaguṇaṃ lākṣāyāṃ rogavān bhavet |
sphāṭike sarvasiddhiḥ syāttathā marakate priye (!) |
lauhaliṅge ripornāśaḥ kāmadaṃ bhasmaliṅgakam |
bālukāyāṃ kāmyasiddhirgomaye ripuhiṃsanam |
sarvaliṅgasya māhātmyaṃ dharmmakāmārthamokṣadam ||
ṣaṭkarmmadīpikādhṛtaśivadharme ||
brahmā sampūjayennityaṃ liṅgaṃ śailamayaṃ śubham |
tasya sampūjanāttena prāptaṃ brahmatvamuttamam |
indranīlamayaṃ liṅgaṃ viṣṇuḥ samarcayet sadā |
viṣṇutvaṃ prāptavān tenaso'bhūdbhūtaikapālakaḥ |
sphāṭikaṃ nirmmalaṃ liṅgaṃ varuṇo'bhyarccayet sadā |
tena tadvaruṇatvaṃ hi prāptaṃ tejobalānvitam ||
mātṛkābhedatantre saptamapaṭale'pi ||
pūjayet pārthive liṅge pāṣāṇaliṅgake'thavā |
svarṇaliṅge'thavā devi (!) raupye tāmre ca kāṃsyake |
pārade vātha gaṅgāyāṃ sphaṭike marakate'pi vā |
kāryabhede lauhaliṅge bhasmanirmmitaliṅgake |
bālukānirmite liṅge gomaye vātha pūjayet |
saṃskāreṇa vinā devi (!) pāṣāṇadrau na pūjayet ||
iti śivaliṅganirmmāṇadravyāṇi ||
atha śivaliṅgasaṃskāraḥ ||
tatraiva ||
saṃskārañca pravakṣyāmi viśeṣa iha yo bhavet |
raupyañca svarṇaliṅgañca svarṇapātre nidhāya ca |
tasmāduttolya talliṅgaṃ dugdhamadhye dinatrayam |
tryambakeṇa snāpayitvā kālarudraṃ prapūjayet |
ṣoḍaśenopacāreṇa vedyāntu pārvatīṃ yajet |
tasmāduttolya talliṅgaṃ gaṅgātoye dinatrayam |
tato vedoktavidhinā saṃskāramācaret sudhīḥ |
pūrvoktavacanaiḥ phalaviśeṣakāmanayā nānāvidhaliṅgapūjoktā |
sā ca pūjā liṅgaṃ sulakṣaṇaṃ kuryāttyajelliṅgamalakṣaṇam |
dairghya hīne bhaved vyādhiradhike śatruvarddhanam |
mānahīne vināśaḥ syādadhike ca śiśukṣayaḥ |
vistāre cādhike hīne rāṣṭranāśo bhaved dhruvam |
pīṭhahīne tu dāridryaṃ śirohīne kulakṣayaḥ |
brahmasūtravihīne ca rājñāṃ rāṣṭrañca naśyati |
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena liṅgaṃ kuryāt sulakṣaṇam |
ityādinā sulakṣaṇaliṅgasyaiva phaladātṛtvamuktam |
liṅgārccanatantre dvitīyapaṭale ||
devyuvāca ||
indriyairahito devaḥ śūnyarūpaḥ sadāśivaḥ |
ākāro nāsti devasya kiṃ tasya pūjane phalam ||
śiva uvāca ||
prete pūjā maheśāni (!) kadācinnāsti pārvati (!) |
rudrasya parameśāni (!) raudrī śaktiritīritā |
raudrī tu parameśāni (!) ādyā kuṇḍalinī bhavet |
varttate parame śāni (!) brahmaviṣṇuśivātmikā |
sārddhatribalayākāraiḥ śivaṃ veṣṭya sadā sthitā |
śaktiṃ vinā maheśāni (!) pretatvaṃ tasya niścitam |
śaktisaṃyogamātreṇa karmmakarttā sadāśivaḥ |
ata eva maheśāni (!) pūjayecchivaliṅgakam ||
iti saśaktikaśivaliṅgapūjanaphalam ||
mātṛkātantre saptamapaṭale ||
devyuvāca ||
liṅgapramāṇaṃ deveśa (!) kathayasva mayi prabho (!) |
pārthive ca śilādau ca viśeṣo yatra yo bhavet ||
śrīśiva uvāca ||
mṛttikātolakaṃ grāhyamathavā tolakadvayam |
etadanyanna kurvīta kadācidapi pārvati (!) ||
ṣaṭkarmma dīpikādhṛtaviśvasāratantre'pi ||
mṛttikātolakaṃ grāhyamathavā tolakadvayam |
trisūtrasya pramāṇena ghaṭanaṃ kārayedbudhaḥ |
svāṅguṣṭhaparvamāṇantu kṛtvā liṅgaṃ prapūjayet |
mṛdādiliṅgaghaṭane pramāṇaṃ parikīrtitam |
phalamuktamavāpnoti anyathā cettadanyathā |
trisūtrīkaraṇamuktaṃ kālottare ||
liṅge vedyāṃ tathā pīṭhe samasūtranipātanāt |
samañcaiva vijānīyāt trisūtrīkaraṇantvidam |
tatra mṛttikābhedena brāhmaṇādīnāṃ pūjāphalasya praśastatvamuktam ||
liṅgārccanatantre tṛtīyapaṭale ||
caturddhā pārthivaṃ liṅgaṃ mṛtsnābhedena pārvati (!) |
śuklaṃ raktaṃ tathā pītaṃ kṛṣṇañca parameśvari (!) |
śuklantu brāhmaṇe śastaṃ kṣatriye raktamiṣyate |
pītantu vaiśyajātau syāt kṛṣṇaṃ śūdre prakīrtitam |
tathā ||
śuklaṃ hi pārthivaṃ liṅgaṃ nirmāya yastu pūjayet |
sa eva parameśāni (!) trivargaphalabhāgbhavet |
kṣatriyastu varārohe (!) raktaṃ nirmāya pārthivam |
pūjayet satataṃ yastu trivargaphalamāpnuyāt |
haritaṃ pārthivaṃ deve (!) nirmmāya yastu pūjayet |
sa ca vaiśyo maheśāni (!) trivargaphalabhāgbhavet |
kṛṣṇaṃ hi pārthivaṃ liṅgaṃ nirmāya yastu pūjayet |
sa śūdraḥ parameśāni (!) trivargaphalabhāgbhavet ||
mātṛkābhedatantre ||
śilādau ca maheśāni (!) sthūlañca phaladāyakam |
aṅguṣṭhamānaṃ deveśi (!) yadvā hemādrimāṇakam |
krameṇa devadeveśi (!) phalaṃ bahuvidhaṃ labhet |
sthūlāt sthūlataraṃ liṅgaṃ rudrākṣaṃ parameśvari (!) |
pūjanāddhāraṇāddevi (!) phalaṃ bahuvidhaṃ smṛtam |
sthūlāt sthūlataramiti pārthivaliṅgetaraparam |
mṛttikātolakamiti prāguktaviśeṣavacanāditi |
śilāsphaṭikamarakatādīnāṃ pañcasūtrīkaraṇamuktam laiṅgai yathā ||
śivaliṅgasya yanmānaṃ tanmānaṃ dakṣasavyayoḥ |
yonyagramapi yanmānaṃ tadadho'pi yathā bhavet ||
tantrāntare ||
liṅgasya yādṛg vistāraḥ pariṇāmo'pi tādṛśaḥ |
liṅgasya dviguṇā vedī yonistadarddhasammitā |
kurvītāṅguṣṭhato hrasvaṃ na kadācidapi kvacit |
ratnādiśivanirmāṇe mānamivāvaśādbhavet ||
liṅgaśabdavyutpattistu skandapurāṇe |
ākāśaṃ liṅgamityāhu pṛthivī tasya pīṭhikā |
ālayaḥ sarvadevānāṃ layanālliṅgamucyate ||
śiva uvāca ||
na tuṣyāmyarccito'rccāyāṃ puṣpadhūpanivedanaiḥ |
liṅge'rccite tathātyarthaṃ paraṃ tuṣyāmi pārvati (!) |
evaṃ devi (!) purā kṛtye jito'haṃ sarvadaivataiḥ |
liṅgatvālliṅgamityuktaṃ sadevāsurakinnaraiḥ |
prayacchāmi divaṃ devi (!) yo malliṅgārccane rataḥ |
tyaktā sarvāṇi pāpāni nirgado dagdhakalmaṣaḥ |
manmanā mannamaskāro māmeva pratipadyate |
dravyaviśeṣeṇa pūjādiphalamapi tatraiva ||
vastrapūtajalairliṅgaṃ snapitvā mama mānavaḥ |
lakṣāṇāñcāśvamedhānāṃ phalamāpnoti sattamaḥ |
sugandhicandananarasairliṅgamālipya bhaktitaḥ |
ālipyate surastrībhiḥ sugandhairyakṣakardamaiḥ ||
liṅgapūjākaraṇadoṣaḥ tatpūjāphalañca tatraiva śivanāradasaṃvāde ||
vinā liṅgārccanaṃ yasya kālo gaccati nityaśaḥ |
mahāhānirbhavettasya durgatasya durātmanaḥ |
ekataḥ sarvadānāni vratāni vividhāni ca |
tīrthāni niyamā yajñā liṅgārādhanamekataḥ |
na liṅgārādhanādanyat purā vede caturṣvapi |
vidyate sarvaśāstrāṇāmeṣa eva suniścitaḥ |
bhuktimuktipradaṃ liṅgaṃ vividhāpannivāraṇam |
pūjayitvā naro nityaṃ śivasāyujyamāpnuyāt |
sarvamanyat parityajya kriyājālamaśeṣataḥ |
bhaktyā paramayā vidvān liṅgamekaḥ prapūjayet ||
matsyasūkte ṣoḍaśāpaṭale ||
aśvamedhasahasrāṇi vājapeyaśatāni ca |
maheśārcanapuṇyasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm ||
liṅgapurāṇe ||
bahunātra kimuktena carācaramidaṃ jagad |
śivaliṅgaṃ samabhyarcya sthitamatra na saṃśayaḥ ||
mātṛkābhedatantre ||
śivasya pūjanāddevi (!) caturvargādhipo bhavet |
aṣṭaiśvaryayuto marttyaḥ śambhunāthasya pūjanāt |
svayaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ prokto yadi śambhu prapūjayet |
svarge marttye ca pātale ye devāḥ saṃsthitāḥ sadā |
teṣāṃ pūjā bhaveddevi (!) śambhunāthasya pūjanāt ||
ṣaṭkarmmadīpikādhṛtakālottare nāradavākyam ||
asāre khalu saṃsāre sārametaccatuṣṭayam |
kāśyāṃ vāsaḥ satāṃ saṅgo gaṅgāmbhaḥ śambhu pūjanam ||
skandāpurāṇe ||
agnihotrāstrivedāśca yajñāśca bahudakṣiṇāḥ ||
śivaliṅgārccanasyaite koṭyaṃśenāpi te samāḥ |
chitvā bhittvā ca bhūtāni hitvā sarvamidaṃ jagat |
yajeddevaṃ virūpākṣaṃ na sa pāpena lipyate |
anekajanmasāhasraṃ bhrāmyamāṇaśca yoniṣu |
kaḥ samāpnoti vai muktiṃ vinā liṅgārccanaṃ naraḥ ||
vīramitrodayadhṛtaskandapurāṇe ||
brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyaḥ śūdro vāpyanulomajaḥ |
pūjayet satataṃ liṅgaṃ tattanmantreṇa sādaram |
tattanmantreṇeti yathāyogyaṃ vaidikatāntrikanāmamantreṇetyarthaḥ ||
liṅgapurāṇe ||
mūle brahmā tathā madhye viṣṇustribhuvaneśvaraḥ |
rudropari mahādevaḥ praṇavākhyaḥ sadāśivaḥ |
liṅgavedo mahādevīliṅgaṃ sākṣānmaheśvaraḥ |
tayoḥ sampūjanānnityaṃ vedī devaśca pūjitau ||
atha pāradaśivaliṅgamāhātmyam ||
mātṛkābhedatantre aṣṭamapaṭale ||
jyotirmayaṃ mahāliṅgaṃ kailāsanagare priye (!) |
tasyaiva ṣoḍaśāṃśaikaḥ kāśyāṃ viśveśvaraḥ sthitaḥ |
pūrṇaliṅgaṃ maheśāni (!) śivabījaṃ na cānyathā |
śilāmadhye yathācakraṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇaḥ param |
pāradasya śatāṃśaiko lakṣmīnārāyaṇo na hi |
pakāraṃ viṣṇurūpañca ākāraṃ kālikā svayam |
rephaṃ śivaṃ dakārañca brahmarūpaṃ na cānyathā |
pāradaṃ parameśāni (!) brahmaviṣṇu śivātmakam |
yo yajet pāradaṃ liṅgaṃ sa eva sambhuravyayaḥ |
ājanmamadhye yo devi (!) ekadā yadi pūjayet |
sa eva dhanyo deveśi (!) sa jñānī sa ca tattvavit |
sa brahmavettā sa dhanī sa rājā bhuvi pūjyate |
aṇimādibhūtīnāmīśvaraḥ sādhakottamaḥ ||
atha pāradaśivaliṅganirmāṇavidhiḥ ||
tatraiva ||
pārade śiva nirmāṇe nānāvighnaṃ yataḥ priye (!) |
ata eva maheśāni (!) śāntisvastyayanaṃ caret |
pāradaṃ śibabījaṃ hi ṭāḍanaṃ na hi kārayet |
tāḍanādvittanāśaḥ syāttāḍanādvittahīnatā |
tāḍanādrogayuktatvaṃ tāḍanānmaraṇaṃ bhavet |
dvādaśāṃ pārthivaṃ liṅgamupacāraiśca ṣoḍaśaiḥ ||
paṭṭādisūtranirmmāṇaracitaṃ śuklameva vā |
puruṣasya yathāyogyaṃ yugmavastraṃ nivedayet |
bhogayogyaṃ pradātavyaṃ madhuparkaṃ kuleśvari (!) |
alaṅkāraṃ yathāśakti dadyāt kalyāṇahetave |
pūjayed bahuyatnena vilvapatreṇa pārvati (!) |
toḍaloktena vidhinā pratyekenāyutaṃ japet |
ādau pañcākṣaraṃ mantramaṣṭottaraśataṃ japet |
pūjānte prajapet paścāt prasādākhyaṃ mahāmanum |
dakṣiṇāntaṃ samācaryya haviṣyāśī jitendriyaḥ |
tāmbūlañca tathā matsyaṃ varjayenna kadācana |
asmiṃstantre haviṣyānnaṃ tāmbūlaṃ mīnamuttamam |
homayet parameśāni (!) daśāṃśaṃ vā śatāṃśakam |
homasya dakṣiṇā kāryā tadā vighnairna lipyate |
tataḥ parasmin divase pāradamānayet sudhīḥ |
tasyopari japenmantraṃ sarvabandhaṃ navātmakam |
vyomabījaṃ śivārṇañca varṇādyaṃ bindumastakam |
vāyubījaṃ cenduyutaṃ tritayaṃ tryambakaṃ priye (!) |
imaṃ mantraṃ maheśāni (!) prajapedauṣadhopari |
pārade prajapenmantramaṣṭottaraśataṃ yadi |
tadaivauṣadhayogena baddho bhavati nānyathā |
tataḥ parasmin divase śṛṇu yaḥ prāṇavallabhe (!) |
varayet sarvakarttāraṃ yathoktavibhavāvadhi |
suvarṇaṃ campakākāraṃ karṇayugme niveśayet |
catuṣkoṇayutaṃ svarṇaṃ grīvāyāṃ sumanoharam |
hastadvaye maheśāni (!) dadyādbalayayugmakam |
balayaṃ śuklavarṇañca aṅgurīyaṃ tathaiva ca |
ūrmī dadyāt pītavarṇāṃ kṣaumavastrayugaṃ śive (!) |
ūrmīṃ aṅgurīyakam |
evaṃ kṛtvā maheśāni (!) śivarūpaṃ vicintayet |
athātaḥ sampravakṣyāmi vidhānaṃ śṛṇu pārvati (!) |
prastare caiva saṃsthāpya jhiṇṭīpatrarasena ca |
praṇaveṇa samāloḍya kuryāt kardamavat priye (!) |
nirmāṇayogyaṃ taddravyaṃ yadi syāt surasundari (!) |
tadā nirmāya talliṅgaṃ punardṛḍhataraṃ caret |
khapuṣpasaṃyute vastre aṅgāre ca karauṣake |
kiñciduṣṇaṃ prakartavyaṃ yato dṛḍhataraṃ bhavet |
avadhūterucyate |
muṇḍarilijje sūtapara ocakodijje maṇḍalabharake khalakarijje |
oho yayāyakāde prāya ocche śivanirmāya |
ocme dijje jaḍake pāṇi vajrasamānakarake jāni ||
iti pāradaśivaliṅganirmāṇavidhiḥ ||
śivaliṅgotpattistu nāradapañcarātre tṛtīyarātre prathamādhyāye nāradabrahmasaṃvāde || yathā ||
brahmovāca ||
purā tvaṃ cañcalaṃ jñātvā tvadagre na prakāśitam |
idānīṃ yogināṃ jñātvā kathayāmi na saṃśayaḥ |
atiguhyamatiguhyamatiguhyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ |
gopitavyaṃ gopitavyaṃ gopitavyaṃ tvayāpi ca |
śambhunā gopitaṃ tantre tantrāntare prakāśitam |
śṛṇu tatkathayāmyadya sāvadhānāvadhāraya |
sargādau vividhāḥ sargā mayā sṛṣṭā hi nārada (!) |
devadānava daityāśca gandharvayakṣarākṣasāḥ |
sarve strīvaśagāḥ śreṣṭhā maithunājjāyate prajā |
kevalaṃ hi śivaḥ śambhurdāragrahaṇakarmaṇi |
kadāpi na manaścakre dṛṣṭvā cintāparāḥ surāḥ |
māmeva śaraṇaṃ nagmuḥ sendrā devāsurādayaḥ |
praṇipatya stuti kṛtvā upatasthuḥ samāhitaḥ |
procuḥ prāñjalayaḥ sarve bhayādgadgadamānasāḥ ||
devādyā ūcuḥ ||
udvāhitā vayaṃ sarve bhavanapi janārdanaḥ |
kevalaṃ hi mahādevo devadevo jagatpatiḥ |
vivāhe na manaścakre kayā vā mohyate śivaḥ |
upāyaṃ cintaya vibho (!) sadāraḥ kathamīśvaraḥ |
yena syājjagatāṃ nāthastat kuruṣva dayānidhe (!) |
iti śrutvā vacasteṣāṃ tato brahmā prajāpatiḥ |
saha tairgaruḍārūḍhaṃ jagāma kamalāsanaḥ |
uvāca taṃ jagannāthaṃ viṣṇuṃ kamalalocanam ||
brahmovāca ||
sṛṣṭā mayā suraśreṣṭha (!) mānuṣā maithunodbhavāḥ |
sarve straiṇā vinā śambhu yat karttavyaṃ vadasva me ||
śrībhagavānuvāca ||
ebhiḥ saha mahābāho (!) gacchāmastvamahaṃ śivam |
karttavyaṃ sūcitaṃ tena anujñāte yathāvidhi |
kintu tadyogyanārīntu vivāhārthaṃ prakalpaya ||
brahmovāca ||
dakṣaṃ gacchāmahe sarve anujñāpaya taṃ hare (!) |
ādyāśaktiṃ mahāmāyāṃ prasādayatu vai laghu |
kanyā bhūtvā mahāśambhuṃ mohayiṣyati śaṅkaram |
evamuktvā tu taiḥ jagmaturvidhikeśavau |
yatra dakṣo mahātejāḥ procatuḥ kāryyamātmanaḥ |
uvāca dakṣaṃ tadyuktaṃ tapastaptuṃ prajāpatiḥ |
brahmā viṣṇuśca sarve te tapasā tosayecchivām |
āvirbabhūva sā devī kālikā gadadīśvarī |
prāha māṃ vaḥ kimarthantu samutkaṇṭhāḥ surāsurāḥ ||
devyuvāca ||
śīghraṃ rūpaṃ yathākāmaṃ bhavatāṃ prārthane phalam |
acirāttat pradāsyāmi satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ||

nyūnādhikaṃ maheśāni (!) yadi caikākṣaraṃ bhavet |

ādau śivaṃ pūjayitvā śaktipūjā tataḥ paraṃ |

liṅgārcanatantre navamapaṭale ||
sampūjya pārthiva liṅgaṃ gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ priye (!) |
tataḥ pañcamukhe devi (!) yaddattaṃ puṣpacandanam |
naivedya trividhaṃ ramyaṃ sugandhaṃ gandhavarjitam |
vilvapatrañca kahlāraṃ tagā mallikāṃ tathā |
mālatīṃ yūthikāṃ devi (!) karavīraṃ manoharam |
padmañca ketakīṃ kundaṃ tathā hyāmalakīṃ priye (!) |
kumudaṃ kokanadañcaiva sarvañca vanasambhavam |
dūrvāñca tulasīścaiva dattvā sampūjya pārthivam |
anyāni yāni puṣpāṇi dhustūrādīni pārvati (!) |

gokoṭidāne deveśi (!) yat phalaṃ parameśvari (!) |
dhustūrasya pradānena samatāṃ yāti pārvati (!) |
yāni yāni ca puṣpāṇi brahmāṇḍe bhāvitāni ca |

yāni yāni ca dhūpāni dīpāni vividhāni ca |
anyāni upacārāṇi yathoktavidhinā priye (!) ||
daśamapaṭale ||
tathā tu vijayāpatraṃ sannyasya pārthivopari |
dattvā tu vijayāpatramaśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet ||
liṅgasya kāmyapūjā tu dvādaśapaṭale |
pūrvoktavidhinā devi (!) sampūjya pārthivaṃ haram |
ātmagehe maheśāni (!) svaśaktyā ca vinirmitam |
svaśaktyā svapatnyā |
cakāreṇātmagehasambandhinā anyena ca vinirmitamityarthaḥ ||
ṣoḍaśairupacāraiśca sampūjya pārthivaṃ śivam |
evaṃ vatsaraparyantaṃ subhaktyā pūjayecchivam |
rahasyaṃ hi tataḥ paścāt māsi māsi śucismite (!) |

tatrādau parameśāni (!) talliṅgañca maheśvari (!) |

amāvasyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ paurṇamasyāṃ viśeṣataḥ |
kuje vā śanivāre vā somavāre'pi pārvati (!) |

vilvapatraiḥ prapūjyātha sahasraiḥ parameśvari (!) |
vilvapatraṃ mahādevi (!) kīṭādidoṣavarjitam |
komala madhuraṃ patraṃ patratrayayutaṃ priye (!) |
vilvapatraṃ vinā devi (!) na hi pūjāṃ samācaret |
pūjayet pūrvavaddevi (!) yathānuṣṭhānapūrvakam |
tataḥ para maheśāni (!) |
mantramuccārya yatnataḥ |

saṃśodhya vidhivaddevi (!) vilvapatraṃ varānane (!) |

pratyahaṃ liṅgapūjanamapi tatraiva |

tatraiva ||

satyaṃ satyaṃ hi girije (!) tajjalaṃ sāgaropamam |
puṣpañca merusadṛśaṃ liṅgopariniyojanāt |
liṅgasya mastake devi (!) yadannaṃ paritiṣṭhati |
tadannasya ca dānena kṣitidānaphalaṃ labhet |
ekayā dūrvayā vāpi yo'rcayecchivaliṅgakam |
sarvadevasya śīrṣe tu cārghyadānaphalaṃ labhet |
sāmānyatoyamānīya yadi snāyānmaheśvaram |
sārddhatrikoṭitīrthasya snānasya phalabhāgbhavet ||
atha riṣṭaśāntiḥ ||
vīramitrodayadhṛtapārāśaramādhavīyayoḥ ||
sahasrakalasairadbhirabhiṣekaṃ karoti yaḥ |

tasyāśvamedhādadhikaṃ phalaṃ bhavati nānyathā ||
liṅgasya sārvakālikapūjāviśeṣo matsyasūkte ||

kṣīrodamathane devi (!) utthitaṃ garalaṃ mahat ||

śatatolakamṛtsnāyāḥ kārayelliṅgamuttamam |
